stories.title: Define PI credibility schema and data contract
stories.description: Create a normalized schema for Principal Investigator credibility including fields: investigator_name, affiliated_institution, prior_trials_count, completed_trials_count, publications_count, fda_approval_count, prior_trial_outcomes_summary, and composite_credibility_score. Define Pydantic models and internal data contracts for downstream services.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/clinical_trials_models.py (existing Pydantic modeling patterns); GAP: No PI credibility schema exists.

stories.title: Implement PI credibility aggregation logic
stories.description: Build backend service to compute PI credibility by aggregating: ClinicalTrials.gov trial history (trial counts, completion status), PubMed publication counts (assumed integration), institutional reputation proxy (based on facility name), and FDA approval linkage (derived from prior trials). Generate composite credibility score with weighted factors.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (existing ClinicalTrials.gov integration); ASSUMPTION: PubMed and FDA cross-referencing required but not implemented; GAP: No PI scoring logic exists.

stories.title: Expose PI credibility via Evaluate Care API
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include PI credibility measure in clinical trial responses. Ensure output includes structured fields and composite score for each trial’s principal investigator.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (existing orchestration layer for clinical trials); GAP: No PI credibility exposure exists.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for PI credibility measure
stories.description: Develop unit tests for scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end PI credibility enrichment within clinical trial results. Include edge cases: missing investigator data, no prior trials, and inconsistent naming across sources.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing test structure and patterns); GAP: No tests for PI credibility pipeline.
